'''November 2001 Sydney tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Sydney, Australia on 18 November 2001. [[Jason Baretta]] won it. It is known from Jason Baretta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3105">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-18-sydney-18-11-01d3105/ sydney-18-11-01], DeckTech (jason "zwitter" baretta, 18 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-18-sydney-18-11-01d3105/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 November 2001
* '''Site:''' Sydney, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Jason Baretta]]
